summary: All endpoints move from /v1/... to /v2/... and FleetSnapshot.api_version changes from "v1" to "v2"; v1 is deprecated and shuts off on 2026-12-01. Orientation changes from Euler degrees roll/pitch/yaw (intrinsic Z-Y-X) to unit quaternion qx,qy,qz,qw (Hamilton, scalar last) encoding the same R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) with non-canonicalised sign. Scalar noise (isotropic 1-sigma, metres) is replaced by required 6x6 covariance (row-major, x,y,z then rot X,Y,Z; position block in m²). Required health (0..1) is added with service/alert threshold below 0.5.

fields_removed.notes: Removed noise (isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty, metres). Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3) where P_pos = covariance[0:3][0:3] in m².

Removed orientation.pitch (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X) as part of Euler degrees -> unit quaternion change. Replaced by orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}: unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded.

Removed orientation.roll (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X) as part of Euler degrees -> unit quaternion change. Replaced by orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}: unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded.

Removed orientation.yaw (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X) as part of Euler degrees -> unit quaternion change. Replaced by orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}: unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly. If you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

fields_added.notes: Added covariance: 6x6 symmetric pose covariance as nested row-major arrays. Variable order x, y, z (m) then rotation about X, Y, Z (rad). The position block covariance[0:3][0:3] is in m². Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sigma = sqrt(trace(P_pos)/3).

Added required health (0..1): composite localisation/drive health from the on-robot monitor. 1 = nominal; values below 0.5 mean the robot should be serviced. Ops dashboards should raise a health alert below 0.5.

Added orientation.qw as part of Euler degrees -> unit quaternion change: unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Build rotations from the quaternion directly; do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

type_changes.notes: Orientation: Euler degrees -> unit quaternion. Removed roll/pitch/yaw (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X); added qx,qy,qz,qw unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from quaternion directly. If you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt. Rationale: Euler hit gimbal lock at pitch ≈ ±90°.
